stram.definition:
v. t. To spring or recoil with violence.
v. t. To dash down; to beat.

stramash.definition:
v. t. To strike, beat, or bang; to break; to destroy.
n. A turmoil; a broil; a fray; a fight.
stramash.translation: n. 骚扰, 骚乱, 碰撞, 猛撞

stramineous.definition:
a. Strawy; consisting of straw.
a. Chaffy; like straw; straw-colored.

stramonium.definition:
n. A poisonous plant (Datura Stramonium); stinkweed. See
   Datura, and Jamestown weed.
stramonium.translation:
n. 曼陀罗叶
[化] 曼陀罗

stramony.translation: n. [植](=jimsonweed)曼陀罗, (治气喘病的)曼陀罗叶
